description: FIND-006 PARTIAL CLOSURE. The is_dormant kwarg was renamed from neg_7day_windows to consecutive_neg_7day_windows (signals intent to caller via name), but the function body STILL only checks `>= 14` (quota_tracker.py:60) without verifying consecutiveness from any list/series input. The semantic invariant (= negative windows must be temporally contiguous) is entirely the caller's responsibility, and no test exercises a non-consecutive scenario where the kwarg is mis-passed. A caller computing total negative window count instead of consecutive count would still trigger dormancy. A REQ-Q5-faithful API would accept the time series (e.g. last N days of roi_7day_jpy) and compute consecutiveness internally.
